stage_conditions.0: runtime attestation; protocol and generation-protocol materialization
stage_conditions.1: cheap machine gates; any blocking failure stops the session
stage_conditions.2: permanent canonical sa/sb controls, ONLY if stages 0 and 1 passed
stage_conditions.3: control characterization; materializes the frozen thresholds
stage_conditions.teardown: delete the pod, verify from the provider that it is gone, STOP

scope_note: micro-preflight only. If Stage 0/1 indicates that hardware, runtime, storage strategy, trainer semantics, evaluation semantics or any frozen identity must change, stop before permanent controls and return for review. Phase A remains separately unauthorized and must not start automatically.
enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, and has no code path to Phase A
